title: German KMK curriculum alignment for Solar Academy task difficulty
question: What do the German national educational standards (KMK Bildungsstandards / state Lehrpläne) define as grade-8-appropriate competencies and content in mathematics, physics, astronomy, and economics, so that the Solar Academy's dynamically generated tasks (currently asserted as 'max. 8. Schuljahr') and the LRN:SSF:* module ladder can be sequenced and difficulty-graded to match?
why_now: gamedesign.md and sepc_solarAcademy.md assert task difficulty is 'max. 8. Schuljahr (Grundrechenarten, Prozent, Proportionen)', and the Solar Academy backlog plans to extend the task library with physics, astronomy, and economics. lib/knowledge/data.ts already builds a concept ladder (Zahlen und Größen -> Vektoren -> Bewegung -> Orbitalmechanik -> Wasser/Mars -> Wirtschaft), which is exactly the shape of a curriculum sequence. Because SSF (a second KUEPER project) authors the learning content NOXIA consumes, aligning both to the official German curriculum would make the educational-quality claim verifiable and is reusable across the ecosystem via the shared Knowledge Graph.
